title: Activation of pro-survival autophagy by a small molecule promoting p62 oligomerisation
authors: Panek J; Sun C; Kataura T; Fielder E; Booth L; Yue W; Richardson G; Reynisson J; Sarkar S; Korolchuk VI
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子SQ-1通过促进p62寡聚化激活自噬，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Autophagy is a critical mechanism of cellular quality control, orchestrated by selective autophagy receptor (SAR) proteins. Pharmacologically enhancing the cargo-targeting capacity of SARs presents an attractive but underexplored strategy for the precise therapeutic activation of autophagy. Here, we characterise SQ-1, a small-molecule activator of autophagy that targets the prototypical SAR protein p62/SQSTM1 (sequestosome-1). We show that SQ-1 sensitises p62 to oxidation and promotes its disulphide-mediated oligomerisation in response to mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (ROS). This ROS-dependent activation of p62-mediated selective autophagy enhances the clearance of ROS-generating mitochondria and restores cell viability in models of Niemann-Pick type C1 (NPC1) disease, which is marked by impaired autophagic flux. In summary, the unique mode of action of SQ-1 enables self-regulated autophagy activation, offering a potential therapeutic strategy for lysosomal storage disorders and a broader spectrum of age-related diseases characterised by defective autophagy.
abstract_zh: 自噬是细胞质量控制的关键机制，由选择性自噬受体（SAR）蛋白协调。药理学上增强SARs的货物靶向能力，为精准治疗性激活自噬提供了一种有吸引力但尚未充分探索的策略。在此，我们表征了SQ-1，一种靶向原型SAR蛋白p62/SQSTM1（sequestosome-1）的小分子自噬激活剂。我们证明，SQ-1使p62对氧化敏感，并在线粒体活性氧（ROS）响应下促进其二硫键介导的寡聚化。这种ROS依赖性的p62介导选择性自噬激活，增强了ROS产生线粒体的清除，并在尼曼-匹克病C1型（NPC1）模型中恢复了细胞活力，该疾病以自噬通量受损为特征。总之，SQ-1的独特作用模式实现了自我调节的自噬激活，为溶酶体贮积症及以自噬缺陷为特征的更广泛年龄相关疾病提供了潜在的治疗策略。
